note: The 'before' state: what the founder knew before customer research. Anonymized (no name, no URL) so web search can't look up today's positioning. Fields follow BusinessBriefInput in docs/CONTRACTS.md. Starting guess and headline are inferred from public pages; confirm with Nick.

brief.description: A mobile app (iOS and Android) that puts nutrition tracking and strength-training logging in one place. You log meals (search, barcode, photo, or plain text) and workouts (sets, reps, weight). An AI coach reads both logs together and suggests what to adjust in your training and eating; you approve or dismiss each suggestion. Planned as freemium: free logging, paid AI coaching. US and Canada.
brief.idealCustomerGuess: Self-led lifters who already track their own workouts and macros and want one app instead of two.

currentMessage.headline: Nutrition and training should work together.
currentMessage.subheadline: One app for your meals, your workouts, and your progress, with an AI coach that sees all of it.
